_comment: IAM policy document for the segs-lambda-role attached to the segs-renew-watches Lambda function. Apply with: aws iam put-role-policy --role-name segs-lambda-role --policy-name SegsLambdaPolicy --policy-document file://lambda-iam-policy.json

Statement._comment: Ideally create a separate segs/lambda secret with only SEG_PUBSUB_TOKEN and SEG_GMAIL_USERS, then restrict this ARN to segs/lambda-* to avoid granting access to all production credentials.
